propositions: A new peer confirmation store must record outbound link additions with full metadata (link_id, direction, pass_id, confirmed_at, source) keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation).
The confirmation write point is the success path of set_relationship in _update_one_dispatch_links, invoked via optional callback that swallows exceptions without affecting link counters.
Unbound targets (where binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must not be recorded to prevent persisting vendor keys in local-id fields.
The peer_confirmations.json file must be tracked in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames to ensure confirmation-only changes are staged and committed to git.
Corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json must degrade gracefully to an empty store without aborting the reconciliation pass.
A link_id extracted from set_relationship's returned mapping is recorded; missing ids or non-mapping returns record null without error.
